tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database schema with users, products, inventory, inventory_transactions, and alerts tables
Build Node.js/Express REST API with authentication endpoints and product CRUD operations
Implement WebSocket server for real-time inventory updates across connected clients
Create React mobile-first UI with Dashboard, Inventory List, and Product Details screens
Integrate Barcode Scanner API and implement barcode scanning functionality with camera interface
Build real-time inventory tracking with automatic stock updates on transactions
Implement low stock alert system with database triggers and notification UI components
Create Add/Edit Product form with image upload and barcode input functionality
Design and implement Alerts screen with filtering and quick action capabilities
Add search and filter functionality to Inventory List with real-time updates
Implement user authentication with JWT tokens and role-based access control
Create responsive bottom navigation and ensure mobile-first design across all screens

risks: Barcode Scanner API integration may have device compatibility issues requiring fallback to manual entry
WebSocket connection stability could impact real-time updates in poor network conditions
Database performance may degrade with high transaction volume without proper indexing and optimization
User adoption challenges if barcode scanning UX is not intuitive for non-technical store clerks
Scope creep from sales reporting feature requests could delay MVP delivery timeline
